title: SUMNO: Spatially Unrolled Multigrid Neural Operator for Fluid Flow Surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2611.16341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data-driven surrogate modeling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for accelerating computational fluid dynamics, and hierarchical U-shaped networks, which resemble the structure of classical Geometric Multigrid (GMG) methods, have become prevalent designs. Modern surrogates built on these designs achieve competitive accuracy at a fraction of the cost of numerical solvers; however, accurate prediction of complex flows remains challenging, and no existing architecture leads across them. In such networks, the multigrid analogy mainly concerns the multi-resolution topology, while their components largely follow common vision practice. To address this, this study introduces SUMNO, a multigrid neural operator for fluid flow fields on regular grids that spatially unrolls a V-cycle into a feed-forward U-shaped network. translated_title: SUMNO：面向流体流动代理模型的空间展开多重网格神经算子
translated_abstract: 数据驱动的代理建模已成为加速计算流体力学的一种强大范式，而结构与经典几何多重网格方法相似的分层U形网络已成为主流设计。基于这些设计构建的现代代理模型能以数值求解器成本的一小部分获得具有竞争力的精度；然而，对复杂流动的准确预测仍然具有挑战性，且没有任何现有架构能够全面领先。在此类网络中，多重网格的类比主要体现在多分辨率拓扑结构上，而其组件设计在很大程度上仍沿用常见的视觉领域实践。为解决这一问题，本研究提出了SUMNO，一种面向规则网格上流体流动场的多重网格神经算子，它将V循环在空间上展开为前馈U形网络。其中，无参数的下采样与上采样分别代替限制和延拓算子，加性跳跃连接则对应粗网格修正。
tldr: SUMNO将多重网格V循环空间展开为前馈U形网络，并采用无参数采样和加性跳跃连接等忠实于经典几何多重网格的设计，提升了规则网格上流体流动代理模型对复杂流动的预测精度。
en_tdlr: SUMNO spatially unrolls a multigrid V-cycle into a feed-forward U-shaped network with multigrid-faithful components such as parameter-free sampling and additive skip connections, improving fluid flow surrogate accuracy on regular grids.
